g.text: If owner wants encryption at rest:
• Repository has no access to keys
Repository can grant access on demand

svg.text: Files are encrypted at rest using CRYPT4GH. Repository can manage access without owners distributing keys.

g.text: On granted access, repository selects the
public key of the final recipient:
Use public key from TRE JWT token
Use user public key from AAI
No need for owners to distribute keys
